title: $* is the stem
objective: Print $* for a target that ends in a known suffix and for one that does not.
hint: $* is the target name with a known suffix removed, so foo.o gives foo. A target without a recognised suffix, like prog, gives an empty $*.

steps.description: one target has a stem, the other does not
steps.stdout:
stem of foo.o: [foo]
touch foo.o
stem of prog: []
touch prog

steps.description: both outputs exist on the second run
steps.stdout: make: Nothing to be done for 'all'.
